Track Name: Chhano Maano
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Janki Gadhvi
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah

Lyrics:

Bas raate aave chandaliyo
Piyu ji ne laave chandaliyo
Aakhe aakho di eni raah ma
Jogan poochhe kya chandaliyo?

English translation:
[The moon arrives only at night
It brings the beloved (Piyu) along
All day long in his wait
Jogan asks, "Where is the moon?]


CHORUS
​Chandaliyo chhano maano
Aave chhe chhano maano
Aavi ne chhano maano
Tadpaave chhano maano

​Chandaliyo chhano maano
Aave chhe chhano maano
Aavi ne chhano maano
Tadpaave chhano maano

English translation:
[The moon arrives quietly and torments quietly... teasing her that her beloved has still not arrived]

VERSE 1
​Fari fari yaad kari fariyaad karu main
[I miss you again and again]

Raat dhale aur naam japu main
Piyu ko dekhu barasu main
Gharar gharar barsaat banu main
Gharar gharar kare megh
Ghate nahi prem
[Love doesn't diminish]

Kare nahi rahem
[It shows no mercy]

Piyu jat aav
[Come soon, my Beloved]

Dhale nahi raat
Adheeri aaj
Juve tari vaat aa jogan
[Your jogan awaits you]

CHORUS
​Chandaliyo chhano maano
Aave chhe chhano maano
Aavi ne chhano maano
Tadpaave chhano maano

English translation:
[The moon arrives quietly and torments quietly... teasing her that her beloved has still not arrived]

VERSE 2
​Baawre se uske man mein na jaane kya chaale?
Uski yeh hath karkash karwat aag hai daag lagaave
Jan-ki parwah nahi yeh rog use bharmaave
Pehle toh thi sehmi ab yeh pyaar mein jag lad jaave

​Meera ka jo hashar hua
Yeh chand gawah.. kis kaaran?
Heer Sohni Shakuntala
Ko mile na unke saajan

​Laaj sharam na aave
Deen dharam bhool jaave
Chhapa akhbaar naya kirdaar bani gheli gheli gheli
[Gheli - Paagal]

CHORUS
​Chandaliyo chhano maano
Aave chhe chhano maano
Aavi ne chhano maano
Tadpaave chhano maano

English translation:
[The moon arrives quietly and torments quietly... teasing her that her beloved has still not arrived]

OUTRO
​Ishaq ki jab lagan lage dekhe chaando chhano maano
Chunvaaya diye zinda jinhe dekhe chaando chhano maano
Nafarat ko tark mile dekhe chaando chhano maano
Prem to ab aah bhare..  chhano maano

Credits:

Track Name: Goriya
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Nishant Mukta
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah
Lyrics Supervisor: Pinky Poonawala
Arranged and programmed by: Yash Kapoor
Mixed and Mastered by - Ajinkya Dhapare @ The Sonic Station, Mumbai.
Dolby Atmos : Team CFP
Head Mix Engineer - Nikhil Mathew
Assisted by - Abhishek Poojary, Gayatri Karekar, Subhashree Das
Mixes supervised by Sunny M.R. for Chordfather Productions
Vocal Coaches: Bhavya Pandit & Divya S Iyer
Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:

Ada tohar ta dekhni ham,
 Pata tohar batawa,
 Rahelu Bombay, Delhi, Patna,
 tohar ghar batawa.
English translation:
(Tumhara andaaz to maine dekh liya,
 ab apna pata batao,
 tum Bombay, Delhi ya Patna mein rehti ho?
 apna ghar batao.)
Lagelu phuljhadi gori,
 Lagelu bam-patakha,
 Nishantwa mange tohse,
 Phone ke tu number batawa.
English translation
(Tum phuljhadi jaisi lagti ho gori,
 tum bam-patakhe jaisi dhamaakedaar lagti ho,
 Nishant tumse bas itna poochhta hai,
 apna phone number batao.)
Dekhni na tohra niyan,
 Gori-goriya…
English translation:
(Tumhare jaisi khoobsurat ladki maine nahin dekhi,
 he gori-goriya...)

HOOK
Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
English translation:
(Tumne mera dil zabardasti chura liya, gori...)
VERSE 1
Chandan badan iya,
 Tohar khushboo ke khazana,
 Aur Nishantwa ba deewana,
 Tohre pichhe, tohre pichhe…
English translation:
(Tumhara shareer chandan jaisa khoobsurat hai,
 tumhari khushboo ek khazaane jaisi hai,
 aur Nishant tumhara deewaana hai,
 sirf tumhare peechhe, tumhare peechhe...)
Ailu jab red colour ke
 Top pahinke,
 Gori, paparazzi sabhe
 Tohre photo khiche.

English translation:
(Jab tum laal rang ka
 top pehenkar aati ho,
 gori, saare paparazzi
 tumhari tasveerein kheenchne lagte hain.)
Tohre pichhe padal raja,
 Tohra chakkar mein rikhadi,
 Tohre upar gaana likhe,
 Baith ke ee likhari.

English translation:
(Tumhare peechhe ye raja pad gaya hai,
 tumhare chakkar mein paagal ho gaya hai,
 tumhare upar gaana likhta hai,
 baithkar ye likhne wala.)
Haath dekhaini baba ke,
 Uho hase lagal,
 Bollas — lag gail ba beta,
 Tohra ishq ke bimari.
English translation:
(Maine baba ko apna haath dikhaya,
 vo bhi hansne lage,
 aur bole— beta,
 tumhein uske pyaar ki beemaari lag gayi hai.)
PRE-HOOK
Bani laika Bihari,
 Kauno kami nahi hokhe dem,
 Akhiyan mein tohar kauno
 Nami nahi hokhe dem.
English translation:
(Main Bihari ladka hoon,
 tumhein kisi cheez ki kami nahin hone doonga,
 tumhari aankhon mein kabhi
 aansoo nahin aane doonga)
Chalat rahi saans gori,
 Kabho nahi ruke dem,
 Sapna tohar gori,
 Kabho nahi tute dem.
English translation:
(Jab tak meri saans chalti rahegi, gori,
 main kabhi nahin rukunga,
 tumhare sapne, gori,
 main kabhi tootne nahin doonga.)
Hamra ke dekhe chori chori goriya…
English translation:
(Tum Bollywood ki
 heroine jaisi lagti ho, gori...)
HOOK
Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
English translation:
(Tumne mera dil zabardasti chura liya, gori...)
VERSE 2
Bola gori, tohra khatir
 Taj Mahal banwa di ka?
 Bobby Brown ke makeup gori,
 Bulk mein dilwa di ka?
English translation:
(Bolo gori, tumhare liye
 kya Taj Mahal banwa doon?
 Bobby Brown ka makeup, gori,
 kya tumhein thok mein khareedkar de doon?)
Gaadi meri two-seater,
 Bas ham dono hi baithenge,
 Lamborghini SVJ mein
 Top gear laga di ja

Mehram marham mangdi payi aye…
My confidante/soul seeks a healing balm…

Jind ishqe di maari
My life is afflicted by love.

Rang tere vich rangi gayi aye…
It has been dyed in your colour…

Rooh saari di saari
My entire soul, completely.

PRE-CHORUS
Duniya tasbih kardi khuda di…
The world chants the name of God…

Main naa japdi tera

Menu chadheya rang tera rang tera
Your colour has coloured me, your colour, your colour.

VERSE 2
Duniya kamli ki jaane…
What does this crazy world know…

Ki jaane ishq khumaari
What does it know of love's intoxication?

Rabb di soorat lagdi payi…
The face/form of God appears…

Menu teri soorat pyaari
To me, your face is dear.

Chaar chufere labhde ne…
They search all around, in every direction…

Oooooo

Chaar chufere labhde loki…
People search all around, in every direction…

Labhde os khuda nu
They search for that God.

Main taan tenu rabb manya…
But I have accepted you as God…

Main namaz-e-ishq guzaari
I have offered the prayer of love.

Main namaz-e-ishq guzaari
I have offered the prayer of love.


PRE-CHORUS
Ishq “Anmol” aye haqq khuda da…
Love, “Anmol,” is the right/belonging of God…

Na tera na mera
Neither yours nor mine.


Chorus
Rangreza rangreza rangreza…
O dyer of colours, O dyer of colours, O dyer of colours…

Menu chadheya rang tera rang tera
Your colour has coloured me, your colour, your colour.

Rangreza Rangreza…
O dyer of colours, O dyer of colours…

Rangreza Rangreza…
O dyer of colours, O dyer of colours…
